[LHYD.9.4.1] An adapter that supports hydration publishes a `service`
declaration per `hydrate_*` endpoint, naming the schemas it can serve and the
caps it enforces, in a `hydration:` block that sits in the `service_decl` of
[LGRA.23.1] immediately before its `response_decl`. The compiler reads these
declarations, which is what makes [LHYD.9.4.2]'s validation enforceable at
compile time.

```
hydration_decl  ::= 'hydration' ':' NEWLINE
                    INDENT hydration_field+ DEDENT
hydration_field ::= 'hydrates' ':' NAME (',' NAME)* ','? NEWLINE
                 |  'max_window' ':' UNIT_LIT NEWLINE
                 |  'max_limit' ':' INT_LIT NEWLINE
                 |  'filter_fields' ':' NEWLINE
                    INDENT filter_field+ DEDENT
filter_field    ::= NAME ':' filter_op (',' filter_op)* ','? NEWLINE
filter_op       ::= '==' | '!=' | '<' | '<=' | '>' | '>=' | 'in'
```

Each `hydration_field` kind appears at most once in one `hydration_decl`; the
compiler must reject a repeated one
(`DS_VALIDATE_SERVICE_DUPLICATE_HYDRATION_FIELD`).

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `hydrates:` | the schema names this endpoint can serve |
| `max_window:` | the largest `window:` it accepts |
| `max_limit:` | the largest `limit:` it accepts |
| `filter_fields:` | each slot a `filter:` expression may name, with the comparison operators it may use on that slot |
